tutorial.step_intro_body: Welcome to your new compound, %s. The best you can do here is survive and if you're lucky you won't have to do it alone.
tutorial.step_camera_body:
Take some time to look over your compound, this will be your base of operations.

Click and Drag to look around.
tutorial.step_resources_body:
These 6 resources are the key to your survival here, you need them for construction and to keep yourself fed and watered.

Wood, Metal, Cloth, Food, Water and Ammo.
tutorial.step_openConstruction_body:
You'll need somewhere to do your basic construction so let's build a workbench.

Open the Construction Menu.
tutorial.step_buildWorkbench_body:
We need a workbench to do any construction. We could do it manually or we can use some fuel on our power tools to get it built straight away.

Click Build or Build Now.
tutorial.step_placeWorkbench_body:
Put the workbench down where you like. Pressing [SPACE] lets you Rotate. Don't worry about placement, you can move it later.

Place the workbench inside the compound.
tutorial.step_foodWater_body:
Keeping stock of food and water will keep you and your survivors happy.

Build a Food Storage and a Water Storage.
tutorial.step_foodWaterSpeedUp_body:
Turns out there's a little more fuel in that generator than we thought, use it to speed up the Food and Water Storage constructions.

Speed Up the Food and Water Storage construction.
tutorial.step_survivorSpotted_body: Your compound has attracted a new survivor. They're on the way, keep an eye out around your compound for their arrival.
tutorial.step_survivorArrive_body:
Make that new survivor useful by giving them a role.

Open the Survivor screen to start assigning.
tutorial.step_survivorAssign_body:
Select the new survivor and then click the Assign button on the left to select a role.

Click Assign Role.
tutorial.step_openMap_body:
Each survivor in your compound consumes 8 units of food and water every 24 hours. We're starting to run low, we should head out and get more.

Open the map to get started.
tutorial.step_showMap_body: This is what's left of Union City. Amongst the ruins we can find whatever we need to survive. Weapons, resources, food and water.
tutorial.step_gotoTutorialScene_body:
In this case your compound needs food and water. To scavenge food and water, you should go to the store and see if there's anything left on the shelves.

Click the store to send a team there.
tutorial.step_selectTeam_body:
Assign your survivors to this team and make sure both of them have a weapon.

You have a limited supply of ammo. Each firearm has an ammo cost per mission.

Equip your survivors with a weapon, then click launch.
tutorial.step_movement_body: Click the ground and the selected survivor will move there.
tutorial.step_combat_body:
Survivors will attack automatically when enemies are in range. You can also force them to attack by clicking a target.

Chance to hit is reduced if the target is outside the weapon's effective range.
tutorial.step_ammo_body: During missions, survivors have UNLIMITED ammo but will still need to reload. Make sure they're covered when doing so.
tutorial.step_scavenging_body:
Search the shelves and other containers here to see if you can find some food and water.

Interact with a shelf to search it.
tutorial.step_exitZones_body:
When you're done, survivors need to be in the green Exit Zones. Survivors outside Exit Zones will be injured!

Get survivors to Exit Zones, click Home, then LEAVE NOW.
tutorial.step_returnSpeedUp_body:
It takes time for survivors to return from missions, the further they go the longer it takes. You can use fuel to gas up and send your vehicle out to retrieve them.

Speed up this mission return in the bottom right panel.
tutorial.step_buildResStorage_body:
If we're going to improve this compound any further, we're going to need to organize our resources.

Build some wood, metal, cloth and ammo storage.
tutorial.step_upgradeWorkbench_body:
In order to build more complicated structures and meet our build requirements, we'll need a better workbench.

Upgrade your workbench to level 2.
tutorial.step_speedUpgradeWorkbench_body:
This is going to take a while, use some of your fuel to speed up the build process with the generator.

Speed Up the workbench upgrade.
tutorial.step_buildProduction_body:
In addition to scavenging building and survival resources from the city, you can also produce your own.

Build a production building of any type.
tutorial.step_collect_body: In a few hours you should be able to collect resources from the building you just constructed. Food takes time to grow, water time to collect.
tutorial.step_junk_body:
There's resources you can use in all these piles of junk scattered about the place. The more survivors you have removing them the faster they'll get the job done.

Remove the small junk pile.
tutorial.step_security_body:
The infected are bound to find you soon, the compound needs it's security upgraded. Security buildings help raise morale.

Build a small barricade or two to slow down any attackers.
tutorial.step_rallyFlag_body:
Before an attack you can set positions for your survivors to gather and defend the compound. Survivors have a separate loadout for defense.

Click a Rally Flag or a Barricade to assign survivors to it.
tutorial.step_infectedSighted_body: The infected are on the way. Get ready to fight!
tutorial.step_moreSurvivors_body: The infected will be back and in greater numbers. You'll need more survivors if you're going to make it. To see the requirements to attract a new survivor, open the Compound Progress Report.
tutorial.step_comfort_body:
Looks like you need to make the place more comfortable. Comfort buildings help raise morale and contribute to attracting new survivors.

Build a bed now.
tutorial.step_morale_body: Keep track of your compounds food and water supply, the security and comfort rating. All of these factors affect your survivors morale; low morale = low performance, high morale = high performance.
tutorial.step_endTutorial_body:
Head out into the Dead Zone and see what you can scrape, scrounge and scavenge. Be careful, you're not alone out there!

Go out to the Dead Zone for more resources!

data.injury_help:
Injuries
During combat, your survivors will most likely incur an injury at some stage. It's in your best interest to attend to injuries as soon as you can as they will affect your survivors performance greatly if left unattended.


How Do Injuries Occur?
Each time your survivor takes damage, there's a chance that they'll receive a MINOR injury. The type of injury will depend on the source of the damage. Infected can leave you with anything from fractures to lacerations.

If your survivor is overcome and is "downed" they will receive SEVERE injury.

Survivors that are left behind on missions outside the green safe zones will incur severe injuries.


Effects of Injuries
Injuries have two types of effects on the survivor. Firstly, all injuries block out a section of the survivors health bar. This health cannot be recovered until the injury has been treated. The amount of health that each injury blocks out depends on it's severity.

Secondly, injuries have an adverse effect on that survivors abilities. If you roll over the injury in the list it will display the current stats and abilities that the injury is affecting.


Treating Injuries
To treat an injury, simply select it from the injury list on the left. This will display the Medical Items needed in order to treat the injury.

All Medical Items have a medical GRADE associated with them. The empty slots show the minimum grade of medical item required to treat this injury.

You can use items of a higher grade to treat lesser injuries if you wish. Lower grade medical items can also be crafted into higher grades through the crafting screen.


Maximum Injuries
Your survivors can have up to 9 injuries at any given time, at that point, some of the injuries will become severe if they continue to sustain injuries.

data.help_effects:
Books
Books act as boosters and game modifying items that can be placed and replaced. They can be found in the Dead Zone as well as purchased through The Store.


Titles and Categories
There are a number of restrictions on the book slots which are based on two factors, Book Titles and Book Categories. At any given time, you can only ever place ONE of a book Title. For example, Anatomy 101 or They're Not Human.

You can also only place one of a book category, e.g - combat, resources etc. Using the specialization books however you can place two of the same category in the slots, with the detriment of having to have the specialization book occupy a third slot.


Cooldowns
A cooldown refers to the time after a book is removed from a slot before it can be placed back into the slot. Books with cooldowns are typically permanent and are generally not consumed when used.


Lasts: X hrs
Books marked with “lasts” are consumable. They have a limited use timeframe once they have been equipped and are removed from your inventory when the timer runs out. These consumable books cannot be removed from the book slot they were placed in once they have been put there.


Slot LockoutBooks marked with a slot lockout refer to the time that must elapse before you can remove the book from that slot after it has been placed there. These books are typically permanent.

morale_effects.help:
Morale
This number represents the overall spirits of your survivors. Each of the numbers listed is an aggregated figure based on the individual stats of your survivors.

Morale affects your compound and survivors in various ways:
- You need to increase morale in order to attract new survivors
- Maintaining morale helps your survivors perform better
- Survivor skills are directly affected by morale


Morale and Skills
In the Survivor screen, you will see the skills each of your survivors has. These skills are affected both negatively and positively based on their current morale.

effect_desc.ninjitsu: "Move silently. Kill with precision. This is the way of the Ninja."
effect_desc.nothuman: "The dead walk the earth as an unstoppable and insurmountable force."
effect_desc.thatsmarts: "Once they have risen, the driving force of the now dead may outshine that of what they were capable of in life."
effect_desc.martiallaw: "All order will be lost. Increased police and military presence, through Martial Law, will see order return."
effect_desc.wifflebat: A beginners guide to hitting things with a very soft touch.
effect_desc.nonlethal: A comprehensive manual for reducing the lethality of firearms.
effect_desc.manualtargeting: "Taking the time to aim your shots will ultimately better your survival over time.
effect_desc.zombiecrits: "Striking with such ferocity the infected now had the ability to decimate our survivors."
effect_desc.motorskills: "Unlearn everything you think you know about your physiology. We have been taught WRONG!"
effect_desc.theyliveagain: "Unstoppable and ravenous, they tore through our group in a matter of seconds. We stood no chance."
effect_desc.whiteflag: "Establish that you want no part of conflict in whatever manner you can. Raise your white flag high."
effect_desc.raisingspirits: "In dire situations, knowledge about how to raise the morale of your friends and family can be invaluable."
effect_desc.generalspec: A guide to specializing your abilities in the General field.
effect_desc.inventorycap: A handy guide to organizing your storage spaces around the home.
effect_desc.baitingyourhome: "In order to attract attackers, simply provide the correct form of bait. Then wait. They will come."
effect_desc.lifespan: "Lowering your constitution by drinking unclean water and eating spoiled food is a great place to start!"
effect_desc.survivorpsychology: "Often times under duress the usual affects on a persons morale can be multiplied significantly."
effect_desc.vacation: Take a break from the humdrum of the every day in the Dead Zone. Holiday without concern!
effect_desc.dec-mission-time: "Getting a job done quickly will push you to the top much quicker than if you'd taken your time."
effect_desc.dec-junk-drops: "Learning to discern what is junk when picking will save you a lot of heartache later."
effect_desc.xpboost: A guide to combat experience and how to maximize your experience in the field.

A map book filled with shortcuts around Union City.
*Does not work on Automated Missions or Raids*

timeline.item: Sharp rise in hospital admissions in outlying towns around Union City. Hundreds of cases with identical symptoms emerge.
Local news networks from locations outside the city report a suspected pandemic.
Attacks by infected are reported as random assaults and murders. Local law enforcement request additional support from surrounding counties.
Government agencies are made aware of a possible "outbreak" on the eastern seaboard.
Homeland Environmental Risk Control agency are assigned to investigate reports of suspected outbreak.
Homeland Environmental Risk Control (HERC) reacts to initial reports by deploying investigative teams to locations surrounding Union City.
Civilians in the towns of Glendale and Claysburg begin evacuating to Union City without direction from law enforcement.
Jonestown, Glendale and Whistlers Grove law enforcement officially request government aid.
First recorded case of infection within Union City is found. Con Johnson of Glendale, a 32 year old male is the first known carrier.
Death toll from unknown virus reaches 10,000. General panic rises, looting and random acts of violence rise sharply.
Government declares a state of emergency in the town of Glendale. Claysburg and Jonestown follow shortly after.
HERC presence in Union City is first noticed. Clashes occur between civilians and enforcement agents as areas are designated for quarantine.
Government acknowledge civil unrest caused by infection outbreak. Request that civilians stay in their homes and await further instruction.
Reports from outside of the state of similar outbreaks are televised.
Law enforcement in co-ordination with HERC work to isolate civilians who occupied hospitals and public spaces.
First recognized re-animation occurs at Glendale hospital under the supervision of HERC doctors.
News reports begin detailing how transfer of the infection occurs.
The town of Glendale in the east of the state is officially quarantined entirely. HERC and US military forces take control.
Reports of refugees from Glendale being fired on and killed by troops when trying to escape the exclusion zone.
Road access into Union City is restricted in an attempt to stem the flow of infection.
Early blackouts occur in the greater Claysburg county as power plants in the south are abandoned.
HERC operations on the edge of Union City end in violent encounters with a number of civilians recorded as KIA. All were found to be infected.
Glendale is declared a disaster area. Government troops are reportedly overrun. It is unclear if this occurred at the hands of civilians or the infected.
Estimated infection rate reaches 60%. Martial Law is finally ordered in Union City.
Residents of Union City are advised to evacuate to the stadium on the northern side of the canal.
HERC in line with the military act to quarantine larger sections of Union City.
Containment proves difficult in the areas of Brookvale and the outlying Whistlers Forrest community. Both suffer breaches and are overrun.
Breaches in 6 of the 10 containment zones inside Union City occur. Infection gathers pace.
All internal roads and bridges are sealed by the military following breaches overnight. Reports of HERC troops firing on civilians are heard.
Claysburg and Jonestown are reported as being overrun.
Reinforcements from nearby Fort Tran are deployed to Union City.
The last remaining TV broadcast goes off the air, radio transmissions follow just a few days later.
Emergency broadcast system comes into effect.
Government evacuations are signalled to cease within the following 40 days.
Military forces dissolve within Union City. HERC paramilitary division remains to help maintain research operations.
Union City falls into darkness as the last of the regions power plants are abandoned.
Estimated infection rate reaches 95% - HERC troops officially withdraw from the area.
Explosions occur in the eastern bay and on the canals as dozens of ships are sunk.
Air traffic ceases. Evacuations by any means are no longer available despite the 40 day allowance.
Reconnaissance aircraft are sighted in the skies above Union City. Unmarked - possibly HERC.
Bombs fall on Union City. The attacks are orchestrated and designed to wipe out remaining citizens along with the infected.
Water supply to the city is disrupted - it is unknown if this is due to the bombing or if this occurred outside the city walls.
A secondary round of bombing occurs - targeting residential districts. Survivors on the ground are driven out.
Surveillance aircraft are seen investigating survivor movements within Union City.
City is declared a Dead Zone. All involvement is withdrawn. Survivors left to own means.
Discovery of automated HERC defences surrounding the outskirts of the city are made. Containment continues.
All hope of rescue or escape has faded. Survivors begin settling in groups within the dead zone.
Dr Phillip Best - a turned HERC scientist discovers that most survivors have a natural defense against the virus.
Significant clash between two survivor packs in the Bricks region results in 10 dead.
Fortifications begin appearing across the city. Clusters of survivors begin acting independently.
Multiple small water craft sighted off the coast of the Docks region.
Helicopters sighted over Union Island.
Multiple transport helicopters sighted flying along the coast and arriving at Union Island.
Heavy activity on Union Island, lights can be seen from the shore.
Reports from other groups that there is a new presence on the Island.

quests.completeTutorial_desc: Completed your introduction to the Dead Zone.
quests.runMission_desc: We need to get out and find more resources, more weapons. Complete another mission. Go to the map to start one.
quests.runMission_complete: This is some custom completion text for a task.
quests.comfortQuest_desc: We're going to need somewhere to rest eventually. Make the place more comfortable by building more beds.
quests.recycleQuest_desc: We can get useful resources out of any item you find, we just need to recycle them.
quests.selfSustaining_desc: In order to keep our food and water supplies up we're going to need to build some gardens and water collectors.
quests.foodAndWater_desc: There's plenty of supermarkets in the area, hopefully there's some food and water left behind. Explore a supermarket.
quests.collectorQuest_desc: Gather from your resource buildings regularly to keep your supplies up.
quests.secureQuest_desc: We need to secure the compound. Build more small barricades in order to lock the place down.
quests.raiseMorale_desc: Nothing raises morale like getting into a scrap. Run some successful missions with your survivors to raise their morale.
quests.gunRun_desc: We should stock up on weapons and ammo, with more survivors coming in we'll need to have the right tools for the job at hand.
quests.secureTheFort_desc: We need to secure the compound further and setup rally flags for when we're attacked. Can't hurt to be too prepared.
quests.resourceRun_desc: With all this construction, we're going to need more building resources. Go to one of the nearby Hardware Stores and raid it for supplies.
quests.gearUp_desc: It would help if our survivors were better equipped to deal with the infected. Search for gear out there.
quests.storageQuest_desc: As we're pulling in more building resources we're going to need somewhere to store them. Build more wood, metal and cloth resource storage.
quests.foodAndWaterStores_desc: We need more space to store our food and water. Build more food and water resource storage.
quests.dropOffs_desc: Make sure we've got a central location to drop off any wood, metal or cloth we find around the compound for collection later.
quests.engineeringQuest_desc: Progress is going to require some more technical thinking, build an Engineering Bench so we can build more advanced structures.
quests.weaponBenchQuest_desc: We can craft our own weapons if we have the right setup, build a Weapons Bench for the compound.
quests.windmillQuest_desc: We may be able to draw some small amounts of power from the wind. Build a windmill somewhere around the compound.
quests.improveQuest_desc: We can improve the capabilities of our buildings by upgrading them, sure it takes some time but it's worth it in the end.
quests.buildItBigger_desc: If we're going to do any larger construction, we'll need somewhere to work outside. Build a Construction Yard.
quests.recyclerBuildQuest_desc: We've got plans for a contraption that should make it possible to recycle objects while you're away. Build the Recycler.
quests.keepingClean_desc: Besides it being comforting, washing should help us stay healthier. Build a shower station.
quests.hittingTheStreets_desc: The remnants of military blockades in the streets make them a good spot to find weapons. You should explore some of the streets around Riverside.
quests.clearTheHalls_desc: Time to try and make a dent in the infected population in Riverside East. Kill infected in Residences in Riverside East.

quests.achievement_2_desc: Unlock achievements to earn XP and rewards.
quests.achievement_3_desc: Unlock achievements to earn XP and rewards.
quests.achievement_4_desc: Unlock achievements to earn XP and rewards.
quests.achievement_5_desc: Unlock achievements to earn XP and rewards.
quests.achievement_6_desc: Unlock achievements to earn XP and rewards.
quests.supplyRuns_desc: Explore the residences in the area surrounding the compound, they should have most of what we need to survive.
quests.getSurvivor_desc: Check the compound progress report in the top right, we'll need to meet those requirements to grow the numbers in our compound.
quests.getSurvivor2_desc: Some extra help around the compound would be useful. We should see if we can attract another survivor to the compound, check the Compound Progress Report.
quests.southTrenton_1_desc: Clearing out some of the infected in South Trenton should make it easier for us to move west of the compound.
quests.southTrenton_2_desc: It's now safe enough for us to move into Trenton, explore the area and see what we can find.
quests.southTrenton_3_desc: There's a Union Security building in South Trenton that we should clear out, sure there'll be solid scavenging there.
quests.southTrenton_4_desc: There's some heavy industry in South Trenton, we should check out the Small Warehouses in the district for crafting and building supplies.
quests.southTrenton_5_desc: We've spotted a few spots in South Trenton that are likely to have good weapon stockpiles. We need to stock up before we go any further.
quests.southTrenton_6_desc: There's a large office building in the middle of South Trenton that might have some useful supplies in it. Clear the street in front of it, hopefully it'll make the area safer.
quests.southTrenton_7_desc: With the street cleared, head into the office building in South Trenton to see what you can find.
quests.trader_1_desc: A stocky Russian man approaches the compound, he claims to be a trader. He's offering equipment for some food and water.
quests.trader_2_desc: The Trader returns to your compound, looking content with the food you gave him. He says he wants radio parts this time around, can't think what for.
quests.trader_3_desc: The trader wants to build something, he's not saying what he just needs the materials.
quests.trader_4_desc: Ivan drops by and mentions he's envious of your generator. He's looking for parts for a windmill to power the place he is holed up in.
quests.trader_5_desc: The Russian is back again, looking for electronic scrap and some metal. He says there's an office in Riverside Waters you should check for the parts he wants.
quests.trader_6_desc: I think Ivan might be trying to corner the market on car batteries.
quests.trader_7_desc: Ivan is looking for components to make traps for his hideout.
quests.storageQuest_2_desc: We'll need to make sure we've got enough storage for all of our resources. Without the necessary storage we can't bring all of it back.
quests.riverside_kill_1_desc: There's no way we'll know if these HERC scientist suits make them harder to put down without trying. Kill infected scientists in Riverside.
quests.riverside_kill_2_desc: Moving targets definitely take some practice to hit consistantly. These 'runners' provide just what we need. Kill runner infected in Riverside.
quests.riverside_scavenge_1_desc: The Riverside hospital is nearby and should be a good source of medical gear. A lot of people ended up there just after the outbreak.
quests.riverside_scavenge_2_desc: The Police Station in Riverside is abandoned, I'm sure it's been picked over already but there should be some weapons there still.
quests.riverside_explore_1_desc: Riverside has a large amount of stores of different types. They're bound to have the supplies we need.
quests.riverside_explore_2_desc: The streets are much larger in Riverside, some of them have military blockades which might have quality weapons. Clear them out.
quests.stadium_kill_1_desc: These heavy set infected are dangerous, we need to figure out a way to take them out effectively. Kill as many as you can around the Stadium.
quests.stadium_kill_2_desc: Fastest moving targets we've come up against. These mongrel beasts are most dangerous in packs. Practice hitting them around Stadium.
quests.stadium_explore_1_desc: The streets and security buildings around Stadium should yield some higher grade weapons than we're used to. Search them and see what you can find.
quests.stadium_explore_2_desc: Plenty of abandoned houses around here in Stadium. Makes sense, most people were herded up and brought to the stadium after the outbreak. Search them for resources.
quests.northWood_explore_1_desc: Northwood is heavily industrial. The warehouses here should keep us in building materials for a long time.
quests.northWood_explore_2_desc: This area is heavily industrial. The warehouses here should keep us in building materials for a long time.
quests.northWood_kill_1_desc: Can never have enough moving target practice. Kill some runners in Northwood.
quests.northWood_kill_2_desc: Surely the new survivors in your group need some practice, take them out for some.
quests.trentonPark_kill_1_desc: There's a gun store here in Trenton Park that should have what we need, clear the street in front of it of infected.
quests.trentonPark_explore_1_desc: Explore the gun store in Trenton Park and bring back as many weapons as you can.
quests.trentonPark_explore_2_desc: The hardware stores and warehouses in Trenton Park are ripe for the picking, they look virtually untouched. Should get good resources from them.
quests.riversideWaters_kill_1_desc: These runners are getting more powerful, we need more practice in taking them down.
quests.riversideWaters_kill_2_desc: Make a mark here by clearing out as many infected as you can. This might be our only way across the river.
quests.riversideWaters_explore_1_desc: Our best bet for resources are these warehouses in Riverside Waters, head in and gather materials and any junk you can find.
quests.riversideWaters_explore_2_desc: The Riverside Waters hospital was far enough away from the initial outbreak that it missed the chaos. There's probably still food and water supply there, check it out.
quests.riversideHeights_kill_1_desc: These former members of the Riverside Heights police department are armored up pretty heavily. Take a bunch of them down, see if you can learn anything.
quests.riversideHeights_explore_1_desc: Big houses here in Riverside Heights, ripe for the picking. Should turn out some good quality gear for us.
quests.riversideHeights_explore_2_desc: The stores in Riverside Heights seem to be as rich and bountiful as the surrounding neighbors, explore and clear them out.
quests.docks_kill_1_desc: One of the last military outposts was by the water here in the Docks. Test the armor of the infected military servicemen.
quests.docks_explore_1_desc: The Docks area has an abundance of warehouses, get in clear them out and pull the resources from them.
quests.docks_explore_2_desc: The military had posts on the streets here in the Docks district when the city fell. Clean up what they left behind.
quests.northWoodEast_kill_1_desc: The once esteemed members of our protective services in Northwood East are getting stronger, find them, take them down. Rest in peace.
quests.northWoodEast_kill_2_desc: These hulking bikers pack a punch. They'll knock you around so keep your distance. Best bet is to concentrate fire.
quests.northWoodEast_explore_1_desc: Union City's finest over-equipped security company has a couple of buildings here in Northwood East, clear them out and grab any weapons you can.
quests.northWoodEast_explore_2_desc: While hitting security buildings might give us some of what we want, the UCPD more than likely has what we need. Hit the police station in Northwood East.
quests.unionBridge_kill_1_desc: These now ex-members of the Homeland Environmental Risk Control agency in Union Bridge are going to be a problem. They're heavily armored, hit them hard.
quests.unionBridge_kill_2_desc: These fat bastards are turning out to be more trouble than we first thought. Somehow they're still very mobile.
quests.unionBridge_explore_1_desc: The hospitals in Union Bridge are some of the biggest in the city, we should clear them out and search for gear.
quests.unionBridge_explore_2_desc: There's a bunch of retail places around Union Bridge - should be a good selection of useful odd and ends.
quests.northTrenton_kill_1_desc: North Trenton saw some rough action during the outbreak. There's a lot of military blockades on the streets here. Clear them out.
quests.northTrenton_kill_2_desc: If we're going to move freely through here, I'd suggest clearing out the residences of North Trenton. Being so far from ground zero, lots of people holed up here.
quests.northTrenton_explore_1_desc: Supermarkets here in North Trenton should have higher yields of food and water stocks for us. Head out and see what you can find in the stores around .
quests.brookvaleNorth_kill_1_desc: The construction sites on this side of the river in Brookvale North are teeming with building resources. Clear the way for our scavengers to come through.
quests.brookvaleNorth_kill_2_desc: The people here in Brookvale North were caught out. I don't understand how the infection made it out here so fast, maybe it came from out of town?
quests.brookvaleNorth_explore_1_desc: After the outbreak, HERC moved in and made use of the city parks to establish bases. Good spot for resources now they've left. Clear the parks in Brookvale North.
quests.brookvaleNorth_explore_2_desc: The subways of Brookvale North became a refuge soon after the fall. Not just a place for rats and vagrants anymore. Clear them out, might be something useful there.
quests.brookvale_explore_1_desc: The police station in Brookvale North could hold some valuable items, but we'll need to clear it out first.
quests.zmas_desc:
Infected Santa made a mistake in thinking this task was over!

Build a Z-Mas Tree so he can drop off your gifts.

Start construction on your tree before 25th of December, 2012 to complete this task!
quests.zmas_complete: You completed your Z-Mas Tree, here's your gifts!
quests.brookvaleWest_Explore_1_desc: Brookvale West was one of the first to be overrun when the infection hit Union City, so its possible that not many survivors have had the chance to come back here. Let's start with the streets and highways.
quests.brookvaleWest_Explore_2_desc: Many of the trucks that used the road out of Brookvale West through Whistler's Forest were based in the local Depot. When containment was enforced there must have been some trucks stuck there.
quests.brookvaleWest_Explore_3_desc: It's possible that some survivors escaped using the subway system in Brookvale West, or even used the station as a refuge. Check it out.
quests.brookvaleWest_Kill_1_desc: A lot of the Infected that got driven to Brookvale West from Whilster's Forest seem to enjoy the local park. Clear them out!
quests.brookvaleWest_Kill_2_desc: The more built up areas in Brookvale West have no shortage of these Infected either. Get rid of them to make traversal safer.
quests.brookvaleWest_Kill_3_desc: These unfinished buildings are dangerous enough without the Infected. Get rid of them so we can explore Brookvale West more easily.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_1_desc: Military presence in Brookvale East was once strong enough to warrant a Forward Operations Base. That should mean there is no shortage of ammunition.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_2_desc: The streets of Brookvale East were a bloodbath back when containments were first breached. Maybe people didn't make it very far out of their homes. There should be plenty of resources there to make the trip worthwhile.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_3_desc: Construction sites seem like a great place to get the wood and metal we need. Go check the ones out in Brookvale East.
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_1_desc: If we're going to want to cross the bridges one day we should start by clearing out the roads in Brookvale East leading to them.
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_2_desc: There is another Depot in Brookvale East, it should help us find the resources needed to forward the compound.
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_3_desc: A large build up of infected is happening around the Military Base in Brookvale East. We should clear them out and make sure there are no surviving military infected in the area.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_4_desc: No one could identify what was in this Brookvale East store. We need to know if there is anything valuable in there.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_5_desc: The industrial sector of Brookvale East looks like a good place to search out. There has to be something we can use.
quests.brookvaleEast_Explore_6_desc: Explore the houses in Brookvale East, they seem promising.
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_4_desc: We should clear out that hospital in Brookvale East to search for medical supplies.
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_5_desc: These streets of Brookvale East are becoming difficult to navigate through, clear them out!
quests.brookvaleEast_Kill_6_desc: The infected numbers in Brookvale East are too high to ignore. Kill as many as you can.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_1_desc: We should check out the Gun store in Brookvale South and surrounding areas for any weapons we could use.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_2_desc: Parks seem to be a good place for other survivors to gather, we should check the one in Brookvale South to see if there is anything we need.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_3_desc: It should now be safe enough to check out the offices and subway stations in the business center of Brookvale South here, if we're lucky there will be plenty of water coolers that survived intact!
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_1_desc: If we clear out some of these infected from the streets of Brookvale South we should be able to isolate smaller groups.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_2_desc: Everywhere near that Police Station in Brookvale South has been leveled by the bombs. If we clear the station out the whole area should be safe to traverse.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_3_desc: With the streets clear and the Police Station safe enough to be a Base, we should clear out these houses in Brookvale South and see what we can find.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_4_desc: We really need to push our compound forward, but we can't do it without the raw materials. Bring some back from Brookvale South and get building!
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_5_desc: If we're ever going to leave this city, we should make sure all routes out are clear. Lets make sure the one leaving Brookvale South is safe.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Explore_6_desc: Medical Supplies will only become harder to find from here, if we check out the Hospital in Brookvale South we should remain ahead.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_4_desc: Brookvale South is getting pretty crowded, let's make us some space.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_5_desc: A survivor is reporting seeing more infected Police in Brookvale South, finishing them off should make life easier for our scavengers.
quests.brookvaleSouth_Kill_6_desc: Let's make one final push to really rid Brookvale South of infected. Drive them out of town!
quests.pinedale_Explore_1_desc: This Pinedale hospital should have plenty of medical supplies lying around, and we can never have too many bandages.
quests.pinedale_Explore_2_desc: Even after this long of other scavengers scouring supermarkets for food, I still think there is more we can find. Check out the Pinedale stores!
quests.pinedale_Explore_3_desc: We should poke around the area of Pinedale near Brookvale Banks to get a better understanding of what we will deal with when we cross over there.
quests.pinedale_Kill_1_desc: The subway system seems to be where a lot of infected get around, and the stations in Pinedale are no exception. Clear them out!
quests.pinedale_Kill_2_desc: The industrial sector here in Pinedale is full of raw materials but we need to clear it out first.
quests.pinedale_Kill_3_desc: There are still a few areas in Pinedale with large build ups of infected. Finishing them off will make every ones lives easier.
quests.brookvaleBanks_Explore_1_desc: These urban and park areas by the river in Brookvale Banks look pretty promising. Go there and bring back whatever you can.
quests.brookvaleBanks_Explore_2_desc: As we get ready to cross the river out of Brookvale Banks, we should make sure that we have the arms we need so we won't get our escape route back over the bridge cut off.
quests.brookvaleBanks_Explore_3_desc: Clear out the areas near the bridge entrance in Brookvale Banks. Once we're strong enough we'll find out what's on the other side...
quests.brookvaleBanks_Kill_1_desc: The streets get tougher to clear out the further we push. Never the less our scavengers appreciate the work. Clear out the streets in Brookvale Banks.
quests.brookvaleBanks_Kill_2_desc: This building in Brookvale Banks could contain valuables but some of us are too afraid of whats inside there. Kill any infected you find.
quests.brookvaleBanks_Kill_3_desc: Giving ourselves easier access to food in Brookvale Banks will be very beneficial. Get it done.
quests.brookvaleBridge_Explore_1_desc: I think its time to cross over onto the heavily built up island. Expect resistance on Brookvale Bridge.
quests.canalParkSouth_Explore_1_desc: The first thing we should do is poke around Canal Park South and see what we can find, and what places to avoid.
quests.canalParkSouth_Explore_2_desc: The UCPD in Canal Park South didn't fare too well against the infected horde, we should see how many weapons were left behind in the chaos.
quests.canalParkSouth_Kill_1_desc: Clear out these areas in Canal Park South to allow scavengers safe access. There is bound to be plenty of valuable resources here.
quests.canalParkSouth_Kill_2_desc: Check out the areas of Canal Park South that are likely to contain building supplies and bring back anything that looks stable.
quests.canalParkSouth_Kill_3_desc: This motel in Canal Park South would be used by people from out of town. Who knows what they brought to Union City on their one way business trip.
quests.canalPark_Explore_1_desc: Many citizens in Canal Park took it upon themselves to grab a gun and fight off the horde themselves. It didn't work out well for them but there is sure to be usable weapons left.
quests.canalPark_Explore_2_desc: No one could figure out what was in this building in Canal Park. Only way to see if it is worth our time is to get in there and check it out.
quests.canalPark_Explore_3_desc: This motel in Canal Park is even larger, and it looks like survivors may have set up camp here after the infection hit.
quests.canalPark_Kill_1_desc: The traffic in Canal Park didn't get close to finding a way out of the city, hopefully the gear is still here.
quests.canalPark_Kill_2_desc: Canal Park seems rich in raw materials, and these locations seem to be a good place to find them.
quests.canalPark_Kill_3_desc: Both infected and Survivors survived the bombing by using the extensive subway system in Union City, with the former eventually claiming dominance. Claim back the station in Canal Park!
quests.newtownWest_Explore_1_desc: It seems the travelers to this city found themselves armed quite quickly once the infection hit. See what you can find in the Newtown West Motel.
quests.newtownWest_Explore_2_desc: Dangerous in life but more dangerous in death, clear out the ex inmates of Newtown West.
quests.newtownBridge_Explore_1_desc: If we can clear a way back to the compound over the Newtown Bridge, survivors getting back will thank you.
quests.newtownWest_Kill_1_desc: There are plenty of infected running rampant in Newtown West, we should clear them out.
quests.newtownWest_Kill_2_desc: It looks like there was a lot of workers trapped here in Newtown West that all became infected. Finishing them off should give us access to whatever materials are here.
quests.newtownWest_Kill_3_desc: If we could find the resources to clear this area of Newtown West out, the survivors that travel to the areas beyond here will be grateful.
quests.newtown_Explore_1_desc: With so many people living in Newtown there is bound to be food and water left behind. It may take some time but seeing to every house will pay off in the end.
quests.newtown_Explore_2_desc: Newtown is rich in everything we need to keep the survivors happy and build up our compound. Find what you can!
quests.newtown_Explore_3_desc: Check out the local store in Newtown to see what weapons weren't stolen in the chaos.
quests.newtown_Explore_4_desc: We don't know if or when more food will come to Union City, we should grab what we can now from Newtown.
quests.newtown_Explore_5_desc: The local security company here in Newtown is likely to have weapons simply lying around waiting for someone to find them. Let that someone be us.
quests.newtown_Explore_6_desc: Figuring out whats in this Newtown building should be considered, who knows what we'll find.
quests.newtown_Kill_1_desc: Clearing out some of the buildings in Newtown will give us enough time to identify the worthwhile places to look for resources.
quests.newtown_Kill_2_desc: Clearing out the Newtown hospital of former patients will give us access to the medical supplies kept here.
quests.newtown_Kill_3_desc: The streets of Newtown were a tough area, full of people who may have carried firearms. See what is left of the thugs that once controlled the area.
quests.newtown_Kill_4_desc: The depot in Newtown looks like it has been hit hard by scavengers, get in there and get whatever is left.
quests.newtown_Kill_5_desc: The alarms aren't going to trigger a response from anyone now, see what the Newtown security team was packing.
quests.newtown_Kill_6_desc: The military bases here have always been good spots to find some quality weapons, clear out the Newtown one and see what you can find.
quests.bricksWest_Explore_1_desc: Checking out the streets and subway system in West Bricks seems like a good place to start. See what you can find there.
quests.bricksWest_Explore_2_desc: Have a look around the West Bricks security building for any weapons we could use.
quests.bricksWest_Explore_3_desc: The materials we find in these locations in West Bricks would be put to good use in our compound. Get to it!
quests.bricksWest_Explore_4_desc: This West Bricks hospital looks like a good place to get some medical supplies. See what you can find.
quests.bricksWest_Explore_5_desc: After HERC forces pulled out of West Bricks, these parks became a home for survivors. They didn't last but these two groups sure left some things behind.
quests.bricksWest_Explore_6_desc: The group is sure the West Bricks supermarket will still have enough food left on the shelves to keep us happy for a few days. Go see how much is left.
quests.bricksWest_Kill_1_desc: The offices in West Bricks are full with employees who locked themselves in, thinking they would be safe. Clear them out to make sure they don't cause us issues down the line.
quests.bricksWest_Kill_2_desc: Clearing out the ex residents of these West Bricks houses will allow us access to whatever supplies they left behind.
quests.bricksWest_Kill_3_desc: We don't know what's in there, but we do know its packed full of infected. Clear out the Unidentified building in West Bricks!
quests.bricksWest_Kill_4_desc: This West Bricks department store was once full of happy shoppers, but not anymore. Clear out the undead shopping addicts who are still here.
quests.bricksWest_Kill_5_desc: The local Police force and Security contractors in West Bricks should have been fairly well armed, and most likely left some weapons behind.
quests.bricksWest_Kill_6_desc: We should now have enough strength to take on the infected camping out in the abandoned military base in West Bricks. Clear them out!
quests.bricks_Explore_1_desc: The residents in The Bricks fared pretty well when the infection hit, and should have some decent stores of food and water.
quests.bricks_Explore_2_desc: Check out the warehouses in The Bricks to grab whatever resources haven't been taken by other survivors.
quests.bricks_Explore_3_desc: The Bricks was a place of early confrontation between different groups of survivors. The ones the died must have left behind some weapons. Go see what you can find.
quests.bricks_Kill_1_desc: Many of the initial survivors would have been break outs from the local prison in The Bricks. They must have stored weapons here before becoming overrun.
quests.bricks_Kill_2_desc: Many raw materials have been left lying around this half finished building in The Bricks. Go clear the area of infected and grab anything you can.
quests.bricks_Kill_3_desc: The levels of infected here in The Bricks are too dangerous to be left alone. If we clear them out we should be able to move onto the next area.
quests.alton_Explore_1_desc: The group couldn't figure out what was inside this building in Alton. Get inside and hopefully there's something valuable!
quests.alton_Explore_2_desc: Take a look around the areas where Alton civilians might have tried to hold out during the infection. We're bound to find some gear lying around.
quests.alton_Explore_3_desc: The streets and offices of Alton should hopefully have weapons lying around. We should also go through the junk past scavengers left behind for anything we could put to good use.
quests.alton_Kill_1_desc: Clearing out these Alton buildings should be a high priority.
quests.alton_Kill_2_desc: Kill the infected around these stores in Alton and see what resources were left lying around.
quests.alton_Kill_3_desc: Finish off the infected hanging around Alton, it should free up enough space to find some weapons.
quests.newtownEast_Explore_1_desc: The medical supplies here in Newtown East should be a high priority for our scavengers, as the increasingly tough infected may cause troubles for our group.
quests.newtownEast_Explore_2_desc: We need to grab as many raw materials as we can, and build up our compound for the better of all the survivors in our group. Check out these locations in Newtown East.
quests.newtownEast_Explore_3_desc: If we are going to push into Uptown, we will need the best weapons this city holds. This military base in Newtown East is full of infected but the soldiers here were heavily armed.
quests.newtownEast_Kill_1_desc: Clearing out the infected from the houses and stores in Newtown East will give us access to the food our group needs. Get to it!
quests.newtownEast_Kill_2_desc: Check these Newtown East locations for firearms. There should be some good quality weapons that others have left, assuming you can get past the infected there.
quests.newtownEast_Kill_3_desc: Its going to be tough in Uptown, and we will need everything we can against the infected there. Clear the Newtown East stores and see what you find.
quests.uptown_Explore_1_desc: We have finally made it to Uptown Union City. Be incredibly cautious of the infected here. Let's start by checking out the housing for some supplies.
quests.uptown_Explore_2_desc: The are looks like it has plenty of materials we could use. Check out the Uptown hardware store to see what is there.
quests.uptown_Explore_3_desc: These infected really pack a punch, check out the Uptown hospitals for the supplies we will need if they catch one of our group out.
quests.uptown_Kill_1_desc: Clearing out these Uptown streets is a must do here. Survivors are reporting large numbers of tough infected.
quests.uptown_Kill_2_desc: The stores here in Uptown look to hold plenty of food and water, but we need to clear them out first.
quests.uptown_Kill_3_desc: There should be some good weapons at the Uptown Gun Store, assuming we can get to them. Clear out some infected and see what you can find there.
quests.uptown_Explore_4_desc: If the stores held plenty of food, the supermarket in Uptown will too. Check it out and bring back anything that looks edible.
quests.uptown_Explore_5_desc: The offices and Security buildings in Uptown could contain a few items of value. Go see what you can find.
quests.uptown_Explore_6_desc: Our group can't quite identify this Uptown building, you'll have to send someone in to see what it is.
quests.uptown_Kill_4_desc: Union Citys finest in Uptown are now nothing but a wall of flesh between us and their old weapons. Wipe them out and secure the weapons.
quests.uptown_Kill_5_desc: The shopping centres in Uptown here were a Mecca to the fashion obsessed, and it seems most of them have hung around. Get rid of them so we don't they no longer pose a threat.
quests.uptown_Kill_6_desc: It seems the Uptown constructions workers took an incredibly long lunch break. Clear them out before it runs into the next 'smoko'.
quests.uptown_Explore_7_desc: Thousands of people once used this Uptown station every day. Now though, it is a haven for undead. Packed more than 9am monday morning. Go see if we can access it safely.
quests.uptown_Explore_8_desc: Whilst not one of the classiest establishments in Union City in its prime, the apocalypse has made buildings like this on in Uptown valuable to pick up that which was left behind.
quests.uptown_Explore_9_desc: Busy downtown deliveries in Uptown could have had anything going through them when the infection hit. Go see if anything valuable is left there.
quests.uptown_Kill_7_desc: Clearing out the infected in Uptown will help us get a good foothold on the city. Get rid of them!
quests.uptown_Kill_8_desc: HERC set up a base here in Uptown quickly after the infections first reporting, it became their central base of operations soon after. They were well armed, so must have left some weapons of value behind. Aassuming we can get to them of course.
quests.uptown_Kill_9_desc: The militarys main base of operations was set up on the waterfront of Uptown. Whilst they pulled out long ago, the heavy build up of infected has most likely prevented others from scavenging the weapons they left behind.
quests.waterside_Explore_1_desc: The suburban neighborhoods of Waterside haven't been hit for crafting resources, there should be plenty on hand.
quests.waterside_Explore_2_desc: There's a length of highway in Waterside and a few shopping strips that might have some basic resources we can use to bolster our stores.
quests.waterside_Explore_3_desc: Some of the wooded areas around Waterside have camp sites that have long been overrun or abandoned. There's bound to be resources here we can use.
quests.waterside_Kill_1_desc: Armored HERC infected are all through the unknown buildings in part of Waterside. Destroy them.
quests.waterside_Kill_2_desc: There's a large police infected presence here, assuming there was something that went on prior to the occupation in Waterside. It doesn't matter now, we just need them gone.
quests.waterside_Kill_3_desc: There's a riot squad and some HERC scientists that were infected and left here in Waterside. A general clean up is needed.
quests.greenplains_Explore_1_desc: The prison, security and police stations in Green Plains are ripe for weapons caches. Find what you can.
quests.greenplains_Explore_2_desc: The roadways of Green Plains are littered with vehicles carrying resources that people were trying to escape with.
quests.greenplains_Explore_3_desc: Get out into the woods near Green Plains and get back to your roots, take down infected and keep it quiet!
quests.greenplains_Kill_1_desc: There's too many infected here in Green Plains for us to operate, clean them out.
quests.greenplains_Kill_2_desc: We don't need much from the offices, but they're close enough to the supermarket and hardware store in Green Plains that it's a problem.
quests.greenplains_Kill_3_desc: There's plenty more infected in the buildings we want to hit for supplies in Green Plains. The warehouses are a problem in particular.
quests.meadowViewWest_Explore_1_desc: This side of the wall in Meadow View West there's a number of places that probably haven't been hit for their gear.
quests.meadowViewWest_Explore_2_desc: The air seems fresher out here in Meadow View West, get out there and gather!
quests.meadowViewWest_Kill_1_desc: We need a lot of the infected in Meadow View West dead, hordes will start to form if we don't take care of it.
quests.meadowViewWest_Kill_2_desc: The military and security establishments here should be cleared out before we head further south.
quests.meadowViewEast_Explore_1_desc: There's a dock and a depot here in Meadow View East, find us some resources in and around those containers.
quests.meadowViewEast_Explore_2_desc: Search the suburbs in Meadow View East and find out what resources were left behind.
quests.meadowViewEast_Kill_1_desc: As we move further south from Meadow View East, we'll need a clear path.
quests.meadowViewEast_Kill_2_desc: There's hordes of infected loitering around the dock and depot here in Meadow View East, we should take care of them.
quests.rollingLakeWest_Explore_1_desc: The soil in the western parts of Rolling Lake is rich with resources, I'm sure of it. Gather up what you can from the farm here.
quests.rollingLakeWest_Explore_2_desc: The prison was controversial for the residents of Rolling Lake West, but I'm glad it's here now. Plenty of gear around the area I'm sure.
quests.rollingLakeWest_Kill_1_desc: This side of Rolling Lake is fairly populated, clear the western side of infected.
quests.rollingLakeWest_Kill_2_desc: The farmstead and prison in Rolling Lake West are filled with infected again, head back there and clear them out.
quests.rollingLakeEast_Explore_1_desc: There's a train yard and a station here in Rolling Lake East. They're bound to have abandoned HERC weapons.
quests.rollingLakeEast_Explore_2_desc: Both the dock and the military base here in Rolling Lake East will have gear that we can use, I'm sure of it.
quests.rollingLakeEast_Kill_1_desc: Explore and clear out the train yard and train station in Rolling Lake East.
quests.rollingLakeEast_Kill_2_desc: One last clean up here before we head south.
quests.southHarborWest_Explore_1_desc: The forest and abandoned farm here in South Harbor West will have some resources that we can use. Hopefully water!
quests.southHarborWest_Explore_2_desc: The shopping districts in South Harbor West might have some hidden weapon caches. If not, you might need to look a little further.
quests.southHarborWest_Kill_1_desc: There was at least some HERC presence this far beyond the wall. Track down the remaining HERC infected in South Harbor West.
quests.southHarborWest_Kill_2_desc: The forest in South Harbor West and the general area should be cleared out to allow freer looting in the nearby commercial district.
quests.southHarborEast_Explore_1_desc: The store houses in the South Harbor East military dock and warehouses might have the weapons we're after.
quests.southHarborEast_Explore_2_desc: The dock and military base should have the weapons you want here in South Harbor East, explore them.
quests.southHarborEast_Kill_1_desc: South Harbor East is the farthest reach for now. Clear the way for future missions. Kill them all.
quests.southHarborEast_Kill_2_desc: The military dock in South Harbor East is valuable as a weapon source. Clear it out.

srv_request_desc.xp_leadIn: I feel like I'm lagging behind the rest of the group when it comes to my abilities. Would you mind taking me out into the zone more often?
I need to brush up on my skills. Could use some time out in the field if you're planning on heading out today.
Feels like forever since I've left the compound, would you mind if I tagged along on some of the runs today?
srv_request_desc.res_leadIn: I checked how much %res% we have left.
We need to talk about the %res% stocks.
We need to talk about our %res% situation.
Everyone seems worried about our %res% stocks.
I heard we're running out of %res%.
I was talking with %srv% earlier about our %res% stocks.
srv_request_desc.res_sentence: Stocks are running low, it would make sense for us to concentrate on finding more today. %*%
Find some time today to look for some more, we're running dangerously low. %*%
The supply is running out, I'm not sure if we can survive here without more. %*%
%*% We're screwed unless you do something.
%*% You need to do something quickly.
srv_request_desc.foodFound: Morale will drop unless you act soon.
We'll go hungry if you don't manage it.
srv_request_desc.waterFound: The dehydration is starting to take effect.
srv_request_desc.ammunitionFound: We can't use our guns without it.
Our guns are useless without ammo.
It's going to make survival hard without more rounds.
srv_request_desc.woodFound: We're going to need it for repairs.
The barricades might need repairing soon.
Our defenses will fail without it.
srv_request_desc.metalFound: The defenses won't hold up much longer.
It could become a security issue if we leave it.
Repairs are going to be needed.
srv_request_desc.clothFound: We need it to make people comfortable.
Never know, we might need more beds soon.
Better to be safe than sorry.
srv_request_desc.kill_leadIn: We're getting a little rusty with our combat.
%srv% and I were talking about heading out.
I think we need to work on our combat skills.
I'm getting pretty tired of being here.
I think %srv% could use some time out of the compound.
%srv% said they're keen to head out into the zone.
%srv% mentioned something about doing some practice?
srv_request_desc.kill_sentence: We should get some practice in today, to keep our defenses up.
Might be good for us to head out and do some target practice.
It'd make me feel safer to know that we're out hitting them back.
We can sit here and wait for them to come to us or we can do something.
Let's head out and kill something, I'm getting tetchy.
Makes sense for us to go and clear some of those things out.
I know I could use the practice out there.
Let's head out into the zone.
srv_request_desc.zombieKills: It should help raise everyones spirits a little.
It'll be nice to rack up some more experience out there.
I think it's a good idea, right?
It's always risky, but then again what isn't these days?

globalQuests.g17_desc: "To ascend, you must prepare. Bring me these items and I will show you how to make a Hallowed object..."

globalQuests.g19_desc: Help Ivan to defeat Mr.X's berserker hordes! He's painted their heads red and attached blades to their arms, the madman!

globalQuests.g21_desc: Ivan has given you the plans to a new type of trap, the Mag of Mayhem. Use the components you've collected to build one!

globalQuests.g25_desc: Track down and kill Z-Mas themed infected to get your reward!

Placing a Bounty
You are only able to place a bounty on another user after they have attacked you. Clicking the “Place Bounty” button will allow you to determine how much bounty you would like to add in fuel. There is a maximum of X fuel that you can add per raid.

Any fuel placed on a bounty is deducted immediately. The Bounty Office claims 18% of the total fuel in all bounties collected, the remainder goes to the Bounty Hunter who collects it.


Bounty Expiry
If after 30 days no-one has added to the bounty and the bounty has not been claimed, the bounty will expire. Adding any amount of fuel to the bounty will reset the expiry time to 30 days. When a bounty expires, all fuel that was added to the bounty will go directly to the Bounty Office.

bounty.list_help:
Bounty Office
Bounties are placed on one user's Leader, by other users. When you raid another user's compound, the victim of the raid is given the option to place a bounty. This bounty then gets added to the total bounty for that user. To collect a bounty, you must injure the target's Leader survivor.

The Bounty Office claims 18% of the total fuel in all bounties collected, the remainder goes to the Bounty Hunter who collected it.

Placing a Bounty
You are only able to place a bounty on another user after they have attacked you. Clicking the “Place Bounty” button will allow you to determine how much bounty you would like to add in fuel. There is a maximum of 100 Fuel that you can add per raid.

Any fuel placed on a bounty is deducted immediately.

Bounty Expiry
If after 30 days no-one has added to the bounty and the bounty has not been claimed, the bounty will expire. Adding any amount of fuel to the bounty will reset the expiry time to 30 days. When a bounty expires, all fuel that was added to the bounty will go directly to the Bounty Office.

Collecting Bounties
To collect a bounty, start by raiding another user who has a bounty on their head. In order to successfully collect the bounty, you need to injure the Leader Survivor of their group. When you have done that and successfully complete the raid, you will be given the option to claim the bounty.

You may choose not to claim a bounty for any number of reasons, it's up to you.

Penalties for the Target
Bounty targets are likely to have suffered a number of attacks as other users attempt to claim the bounty.

Alliances
Forming an alliance allows you to join forces with other survivors in the Dead Zone in order to complete tasks and compete against rival Alliances. Currently you're only able to create the basis for an Alliance, more functionality is coming.


Recruiting Alliance Members
Inviting players to your alliance must be done through the Communications System. The Founder needs to click the name of the person you wish to invite and select "Alliance Invitation". The player will then receive a request and Accept of Reject the offer.


Disbanding / Leaving an Alliance
Currently we're not allowing players to disband Alliances. Members can leave an Alliance by accessing their options in the Members screen. Founders currently cannot leave their Alliance. In future we will have the ability for Founders to promote someone into their position, with the promoted player becoming the new Founder.

We will also add the ability for Founders to disband the Alliance completely, removing all members and history of it's actions.

alliance.alliance_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

Alliances

Alliances allow groups of like-minded players to band together and battle it out in the Dead Zone for Fuel rewards. Alliances earn War Points through raiding and defending against enemy Alliances.

An Alliance-only currency called Tokens are earned by cooperating and completing Tasks together as an Alliance. Tokens can be spent on Boosts, which provide beneficial effects to all Alliance members.

Joining an Alliance

To join an existing Alliance, you need to be invited via the in-game Communications system. Once invited, you may accept the invitation, after which you'll become a member of the Alliance. If a War Round is currently in progress, you'll be placed into Enlisting mode.

As a new member in Enlisting mode, you won't be able to contribute to the current War Round. This means you won't be able to contribute or donate to War Tasks, or earn War Points for you Alliance until the next War Round begins.

Creating an Alliance

As a veteran Survivor, you may want to start your own Alliance. If you're not already in an Alliance, you can create your own Alliance by visiting the Create page within the Alliances Window. A fee of 1000 Fuel is required to start a new Alliance.

As the Founder of your Alliance, you'll be able to control every aspect of your Alliance, from the design of your Alliance banner, which players you invite and their ranks within the Alliance to how Alliance Tokens are spent.


If your Alliance is created during a War Round, you will be placed into Enlisting mode and your Alliance will not able to rank during the round. You must wait for a new War Round to begin before your Alliance can gain a ranking.

Rewards

The Top 3 ranked Alliances at the end of a War Round are given Fuel rewards, which are split evenly among the Top 10 members within the Alliance.

For more information, visit: deadzonegame.com/alliances.
alliance.boost_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

War Boosts

War Boosts provide all members of the Alliance (unless they're still Enlisting) with beneficial effects for the remaining duration of the round.

By purchasing all four of the primary War Boosts in the current round, the Alliance will automatically unlock the Bonus Boost, which provides even more benefits to the entire Alliance.

The Token cost of an Alliance Boost is proportional to the number of members in the Alliance that are able to contribute War Points, as well as the time remaining in the current round. As the end of the round draws closer, the cost of War Boosts will reduce. However, their effects only last until the end of the round.

Alliance members that join the Alliance after the beginning of a round will not be able to contribute War Points to the round, and therefore will not be awarded any purchased Boosts for the round.
alliance.task_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

War Tasks

Each member within the Alliance can contribute to War Tasks, with the exception of those members that're still Enlisting.

Cooperating and completing tasks as an Alliance earns Tokens for the Alliance, which can be spent on War Boosts.

The number of Tokens earned for the alliance by completing a task is proportional to the number of members that can contribute War Points to the current round.

Some tasks will require a manual contribution from Alliance members, such as donating resource stocks (for example, Food, Wood or Ammo). Other tasks, such as killing Infected or collecting items, will be automatically contributed to as you complete missions.
alliance.token_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

Alliance Tokens

Alliance Tokens are earned through cooperation amongst the Alliance and completing War Tasks. Tokens can be spent on War Boosts, which provide beneficial effects for all members of the Alliance, except those that're still Enlisting.
alliance.war_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

Alliance War

During each War round, Alliances are ranked based on their total War Points earned. The top ranking Alliances and players receive Fuel rewards at the end of a round.

War Points

War Points are the primary ranking value. They are earned by successfully raiding the compounds of players in competing Alliances and successfully defending your compound against raids by other Alliances.

The number of War Points gained by succesfully raiding or defending varies, depending on the difference in level between you and the enemy player, as well as the difference in rank between your Alliance and the enemy player's Alliance.

Losing an offensive raid (ie. Raiding a competing Alliance player) or unsuccessfully defending your compound against an Alliance enemy will result in your Alliance losing points.

The number of War Points gained by succesfully raiding or defending varies, depending on the difference in level between you and the enemy player, as well as the difference in rank between your Alliance and the enemy player's Alliance. However, the amount of points lost for an unsuccessful defense will be less than that for an unsuccessful offensive raid.

Raiding or defending against a player in your own Alliance yields no gain or loss in War Points.

Efficiency

The Efficiency rating for each Alliance is a ratio of the number of total wins (successful raids and defenses) versus total losses (unsuccessful raids and defenses). It is used to determine the rankings of Alliances when their War Points values are equal. In the case of two or more Alliances with the same War Points value, the Alliance with the highest Efficiency rating (ie. more wins vs. losses) will be higher ranked.

Rewards

At the end of an Alliance War round, the Top 3 ranking Alliances (by War Points) receive a Fuel reward, of which is split evenly amongst Top 10 Ranking players within each Alliance. Players are ranked internally within their Alliance by total War Points earned for the Alliance during the round.

War Targets

If you are able to contribute War Points to the current round, the War Targets tab will be available to you. This list displays a collection of Alliances with a ranking close to your Alliance's ranking, from which you can view the members of that Alliance and launch raids against them.

This provides a simple way to find worthy War Opponents to help futher your Alliance's standing.
alliance.members_help:
For more information, visit:
deadzonegame.com/alliances

Members

This page displays the players that are members of your Alliance and their rank. Depending on your rank's permissions, you may be able to promote or demote other members, or remove them from the Alliance completely.

Enlisting

If the Alliance is created, or a new member joins the Alliance, during the course of a War Round, the joining member (or Founder) is placed into Enlisting mode. While in Enlisting mode, a member cannot contribute to the Alliance in any way. This includes a restriction on earning War Points for the current round, as well as contributing to War Tasks or spending Alliance Tokens.

Members in Enlisting mode will NOT receive any effects for currently active or newly purchased War Boosts.

At the beginning of the NEXT War Round, all Enlisting members will become active and will be able to contribute to the Alliance. New Alliances created during a War Round will remain unranked (they cannot earn War Points) for the duration of the current War Round. You must wait until the next War Round to gain a Leaderboard ranking.

Leaving the Alliance

If you wish to leave the Alliance, click the Settings icon next to your name within the member list, then click LEAVE ALLIANCE. You will be asked to confirm this action.

Inviting and Removing Members

If your rank permissions allow it, you may be able to invite new members or remove existing members from the Alliance.

To invite a player to the Alliance, you must be connected to the Communications System. From there, clicking a player's name will open a menu from which you can select ALLIANCE INVITE to invite them to join your Alliance. You can only invite players that are NOT currently in an Alliance.

To remove an existing member from the Alliance, click the Settings icon next to the user's name, and click REMOVE MEMBER. You will need to confirm this action. The member will be removed immediately.

Member Ranks

Each member in the Alliance is assigned a Rank. The player that created the Alliance is automatically assigned the rank of Founder. The Founder of the Alliance has full permissions and can control all aspects of the Alliance.

When a new member joins the Alliance, they are assigned the rank of Recruit. This is the most basic rank and contains no administrator permissions. Recruits and other early ranks can only contribute War Points to the Alliance and donate or contribute to War Tasks.

If your assigned rank has the correct permissions, you may be able to change another member's rank. To change the rank of a member, click the Settings icon next to the member's name, then click CHANGE RANK.

Any member of the Alliance can click the PREVIEW RANKS button to view the list of ranks available and their permissions. From this menu, the Founder of the Alliance has the option to change the name of Ranks. Any changes to rank names are displayed immediately within the Members list.

Disbanding

This button is only visible to the Founder of the Alliance. Clicking this button allows the Founder to disband the entire Alliance. This action must be confirmed. If the Alliance is disbanded, all members within the Alliance will be removed from the Alliance, and the Alliance will be removed from the Leaderboard.

The Alliance will cease to exist after this action, and the Alliance's name and tag will become available for registration by other players.

THIS ACTION CANNOT BE UNDONE. An Alliance CANNOT be reinstated if disbanded.
alliance.indi_help:
Individual War Rewards

When competing in the current War Round, any War Points you earn will be added to your Individual War Rewards progress. At the end of the round, you will be automatically rewarded based on the amount of points you have.

As you gain points and reach the different tiers, the prize you will receive will change.

Getting your Rewards

Once the round has ended, the rewards will be added to your account. If you leave your alliance during a round, you will lose all War Points and any rewards you would have recieved.
